smalltalk: Can we just talk for a bit?
Funny how the city never really sleeps.
I needed a break from everything.
What do you do for fun?
Just wanted to see how you were.
action: Look at that building over there.
Is this a safe place to stop?

memoryQueries.text: Remember that old bike I used to have? Went to a guy named Hideo.
Still funny to me, putting that car through a shop window in Little China.
Don't boss me around, you know how I get when someone gives orders.
How's Mitch holding up? I keep wondering.
If it comes down to Saul, I'm on your side, no questions.
That Heywood job went bad, three security guards never walked out.
I wiped out a full Tyger Claw crew alone, remember hearing about that?
Give me a precision rifle over a heavy assault gun any day.
Do you still know that guy at Lizzie's who handles electronic locks?
I got you that camera footage and never asked for a favor back.
Cross me once and I'll hold it against you for a long, long time.
You know I hate how the corps try to own everything.
If we get caught on this, I'll take the heat.
I've been out to Laguna Bend, so I get why you left.
Remember I warned you about the breach before it hit your system?
I'd take someone with real skills over a fancy corporate degree.
I was there in the Relic with you, not just riding along in your head.
That corpo job pissed me off, double-crossed again, reminds me of my own past.
I don't follow orders blindly, I question every job I take.
My voice broke when I talked about losing someone, I know that pain.
I said I'd try to get Alt back if there was any way at all.
I turned down a huge payday once because it went against my principles.
I beat a corpo AI head on, my cyberware held up.
I won't give up my values, whatever it costs me.
I know a bit about boxing, I respect how honest the sport is.
That big implant overhaul, I paid you double and didn't make you ask.
I like surgeons who tell me what they're doing and why.
I asked how your life is outside the clinic, because I care about you.
I won't trash your clinic or point the corps at you, I promised.
I know military implants and where their limits are.
After that job I came in with nerve damage in my hand.
Give me straight advice, not a corporate sales pitch.
